# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This knowledge base is distilled directly from genuine sales calls, customer enquiries, dealer price negotiations, product discovery conversations, and commercial objection handling for **Crayon Roofing & Structures** (also referenced in calls as Crayon Roofing, Cryon, Creon, and i-roofing). 

### Operational & Sales Context
- **Primary Business**: Commercial distribution and processing of metal roofing sheets, color-coated coils, galvalume sheets, polycarbonate daylight panels, structural purlins, roofing accessories, self-drilling fasteners, and welding consumables.
- **Core Market Dynamics**: Daily steel raw-material price revisions (fluctuating per kg and per square meter), brand-driven
